questions.question: What are the two main things you should compare between texts?
questions.correctAnswer: Perspectives (viewpoints) and methods (how they convey those viewpoints).
questions.explanation: Answer: Perspectives (viewpoints) and methods (how they convey those viewpoints).

questions.question: Name three comparative connectives for showing differences.
questions.correctAnswer: However, in contrast, whereas, on the other hand, unlike.
questions.explanation: Answer: However, in contrast, whereas, on the other hand, unlike.
